chosen.title: Dumbbell Reverse Lunges | How To | Proper Form & Technique
chosen.description:
Dumbbell Reverse Lunges | How To | Proper Form & Technique

The Dumbbell Reverse Lunges work the quadriceps at the front of your upper legs. Let’s look at them:

1. Stand with feet shoulder width apart or slightly less
2. Keep your torso upright and hold the dumbbells down at your sides with a neutral grip
3. This is the starting position
4. Now place your right foot behind and land it on your toes 
5. Go down by bedding both your legs until the knee of the rear leg almost touches the floor
6. Bring your right foot back to the starting position
7. Repeat this movement with the left foot
8. Remember to breathe normally
9. Complete the desired number of reps by alternating between the legs

And that’s how you do Dumbbell Reverse Lunges or Dumbbell Back Lunge.

candidates.title: ✅ The PERFECT Dumbbell Static Lunge
candidates.description:
✅ The PERFECT Dumbbell Static Lunge 
Avoid common mistakes and maximize your gains with these tips:
1️⃣ Feet Position – Keep your feet hip-width apart for better balance. Don’t line them up like you’re on a tightrope.
2️⃣ Back Foot – Stay on the ball of your rear foot with your heel lifted to maintain stability.
3️⃣ Spine Alignment – Keep a neutral spine. No rounding, no excessive arching.
4️⃣ Full Range – Lower yourself until your back knee nearly touches the floor. Don’t cheat with partial reps!
